body:

title: Apelando mi infraccion

replies.author: Javipepe
replies.body:
TRANSLATION: 

Hello, well after 6 months of being banned from playing with my friends on this server I want to be unbanned, my ban was because of too many infractions, the ones that are hack-related are because I used them before but now I'm better at minecraft and I'll never use them anymore. The ones of hackusating are because I didn't understand what pingers, combos and all that pvp things were so I accused a lot for hacking. I want to be unbanned to be able to play with my friends because there is no similar server as this is 0 lag, contains my favorite gamemodes and has a great community. I hope it's possible to get unbanned, looking forward to your reply. Greetings :)
